title: Special Grace of God
definition: Special grace is God's saving grace by which He redeems sinners through Jesus Christ and brings them into eternal life.
summary: Saving grace rescues sinners through Christ, not through human merit.
christFocus: Jesus is the gift and mediator of saving grace, giving Himself for undeserving sinners.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Special grace is God's saving favor toward sinners in Christ. Unlike common grace, it does not merely sustain life in a fallen world; it brings salvation, forgiveness, new birth, and eternal life.

This grace is undeserved. It is not earned by works, religious effort, or moral improvement. It comes through Christ and is received by faith.

Special grace humbles the proud and lifts the broken. It declares that God saves because He is merciful, not because sinners are worthy.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people confuse general blessings with salvation or believe they must earn God's favor. Special grace matters because it clarifies that salvation comes only through Christ.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Rest in saving grace and stop boasting in yourself. Receive grace by faith, and let grace train you to live in holiness and gratitude.
